meta.name: The Bequeathed
meta.description: After the death of an unknown uncle, a woman inherits a burial ground and finds herself in the center of a string of murders and dark secrets.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: At her unknown uncle’s funeral, Yoon Seo-ha meets Kim Young-ho, a man claiming to be her half brother. Meanwhile, detective Choi Sung-jun chases new leads.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Seo-ha suspects Young-ho may have a hand in a recent tragic murder. An age-old conflict between chief detective Park Sang-min and Sung-jun surfaces.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: The police refuse to arrest Young-ho, forcing Seo-ha to ask a private investigator to look for evidence. Sung-jun dives into Young-ho's shamanic past.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Young-ho receives an ominous warning about a family burial ground and runs after Seo-ha. Sang-min hastily orders a search of Young-ho's home.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Seo-ha's attempts at intimidating Young-ho go awry. Sung-jun and Sang-min track down a stranger who may be connected to the killings.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Confronted with the shocking truth about the burial ground, Seo-ha finds herself in peril — and she must devise a last-ditch effort to save herself.

meta.slogan: An inescapable fate. A desire that calls for blood.
